claims: Rita's Italian Ice is celebrating the first day of spring on Friday, March 20, 2026.
Rita's Italian Ice is giving away one free 6-ounce Italian Ice to each guest who visits a location nationwide on Friday, March 20, 2026.
The annual event runs all day.
The annual event includes a new "Mystery PEEPS®" flavor.
The annual event includes classics like cherry and lemon.
Rita’s Free Ice Day 2026 is on Friday, March 20, 2026, throughout the day.
Rita’s Free Ice Day 2026 offers a free 6-ounce Italian Ice per customer.
Rita’s Free Ice Day 2026 is at all Rita’s locations nationwide.
A mystery PEEPS® flavored ice will be available.
A contest to guess the flavor runs from March 20-29, 2026.
Rita’s Free Ice Day is a long-standing tradition (>25 years) to welcome spring.
Rita’s Free Ice Day typically serves around one million cups.
